title: App updates
stopped: The update operation stopped. Check the guidance below.
bootReadyFailed: Could not notify the update monitor that the initial screen loaded.
readFailed: Could not read update status. Reload the status to try again.
actionFailed: Could not confirm the update result. Reload the status before trying again.
reconnect: After updating, reconnect kb-app MCP in each AI app you use. Restarting kb-app alone does not update the AI connections.

phases.unavailable: Updates are unavailable in this app.
phases.idle: Use the button below to check for updates.
phases.up_to_date: This app is up to date.
phases.verifying: Checking the update signature and compatibility…
phases.ready: The update has been verified. Restart to apply it.
phases.installing: Applying the update. Please wait for the app to restart…

failures.not_configured: This distribution has no update service configured. Please wait for a distribution that supports updates.
failures.unsupported_platform: In-app updates require a supported macOS app. They are unavailable in browser previews and other environments.
failures.busy: Another update operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
failures.network: Could not connect to the update service. Check your connection and try again.
failures.signature: Could not verify the update signature. Check for updates again, then download it again.
failures.invalid_package: Could not verify the update package. Check for updates again, then download it again.
failures.incompatible: This update is incompatible with your stored data or environment. Check again for a compatible update.
failures.storage: Could not read or write update files. Check available storage and access permissions, then try again.
failures.install_failed: Could not install the update. Check available storage and access permissions, then try again.
failures.restart_failed: The updated app could not start, so the previous version was restored. Check for updates again.
